annotations.annotation: The plot illustrates the trend of missing steps over a range of some variable, comparing two conditions: "w.o. extension" and "extension". The x-axis is labeled with no title, using a linear scale with values ranging from 0 to 4 with regular intervals at whole numbers (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). The y-axis is labeled "Missing Step", also on a linear scale, with values ranging from 0.820 to 0.860 and tick labels at intervals of 0.010. The blue dashed line with circular markers represents the "w.o. extension" condition, starting at approximately 0.837 at x = 0 and decreasing to about 0.819 at x = 3 and 4. The orange solid line with triangular markers shows the "extension", beginning at about 0.863 at x = 0 and decreasing to roughly 0.841 at x = 4. Both lines exhibit a generally declining trend across the x-axis. They don't intersect each other. A legend is given top right.
